title: Interfaces IA consolidation v2 (grouped manager + inline quick add)
acceptance_criteria: Interfaces navigation keeps a dedicated `Interfaces` sidebar section with only high-level entries (`Setup Wizard`, `All Interfaces`).
`/network/interfaces` acts as the primary ethernet/VLAN manager with quick-add actions and without duplicating full family-link navigation.
`Create Interface` opens a single wizard-style flow with a type selector spanning all interface families.
Main Interfaces page shows non-Ethernet family instances in a consolidated additional-families inventory section.
`Common Interface Actions` panel is removed from `/network/interfaces` because actions are handled by the wizard type selector.
Family actions route to dedicated per-interface pages.
Interfaces page includes a clear Setup Wizard button.
Existing detailed interface pages remain reachable for advanced settings and compatibility.
Sidebar label for `/network/interfaces` is restored to `All Interfaces`.
Inline PPPoE quick-add supports source interface selection with description-first labels.
Inline VTI and VXLAN quick-add flows are available from Interface Manager for common setup.
Inline Tunnel quick-add flow is available with required source/remote validation.
Build/typecheck/runtime smoke pass after IA changes.
assumptions: Per-type detailed editors remain the source of truth for advanced protocol-specific fields in v1.
A later slice will add shared inline create/edit drawer modules in the unified manager.
Playwright browser smoke remains blocked on this host due missing `libnspr4.so`.

tasks.notes: Audited overlap and grouped families into Core & L2, Overlay & Secure, and Access & WAN.
Interfaces sidebar now includes direct family entries under the `Interfaces` section for dedicated page navigation.
Implemented unified interface family hub with grouped filters and family cards.
Added grouped interfaces routes to smoke probes.
Added inline quick-add modal flows in unified manager for Dummy, Loopback, and PPPoE families using existing APIs, including description-first source-interface selection for PPPoE.
Extended inline quick-add coverage to VTI and VXLAN families while preserving advanced pages.
Added tunnel-family quick-add flow to unified manager with required source/remote validation.
Add inline quick-edit (existing-value prefill) for quick-add-enabled families; preserve sidebar as a single Interfaces entry with setup-wizard access on page.
Family card action now renders `Current` for the exact active view so no-op open actions are explicit.
Reverted interface-family navigation to dedicated page actions only and removed inline workspace/embed panel behavior.
Restored interface family links in the left sidebar under `Interfaces` while preserving dedicated family pages.
Removed full family-link duplication from Interface Manager and renamed sidebar child entry back to `All Interfaces`.

Unified `Create Interface` flow now supports all interface families with type-specific fields and existing API wrappers; Ethernet/VLAN launch dedicated modals from the same wizard. Main Interfaces page now aggregates non-Ethernet family instances in an additional inventory section.
Removed interface-family bulk links from sidebar and removed `Common Interface Actions` card from Interfaces page, keeping one wizard-driven create workflow.

commands.test: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s smoke:runtime
